adult_dose: IV push 20–80 mg (naive) or 1–2× total oral daily dose (tolerant); infusion 0.05–0.4 mg/kg/hr for resistant fluid overload.
renal_adjustment: Higher doses often needed in CKD; push rate should not exceed 4 mg/min to avoid ototoxicity.
max_dose: Single dose typically ≤ 200 mg IV; daily doses up to 600 mg seen in refractory HF. Push rate ≤ 4 mg/min.
indications: Acute decompensated heart failure / pulmonary edema
key_monitoring: Urine output (target >0.5 mL/kg/hr in decompensated HF)

provenance.source: AHA Heart Failure guideline + Lexicomp summary
